blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO — Veronica Burton hit a deep 3-pointer that put Golden State ahead with 41 seconds left and converted two free throws in the closing seconds, Tiffany Hayes had 21 points, and the Valkyries held off the Las Vegas Aces 83-81 on Wednesday night for a 2-0 lead in the best-of-five WNBA semifinal series. “I think I held my breath the whole time the ball was in the air,” Hayes said about watching Burton’s clutch shot.
